name: Amount collected but not brought to account
Amount drawn on self cheques not entered in the petty cash book
Amount not realized from lease on account of lease of land or Fish Ponds, House Tax from house owners, Rent of Shops from tenants
Cash Balance not handed over at the time of change of incumbent
Closing cash Balance not taken as Opening cash Balance
Drawl of amount for a particular claim more than once
Drawl of amount without vouchers/proper vouchers
Drawl of excess amount due to assignment of incorrect amount
Drawl of excess amount due to wrong totaling of vouchers
Drawl of excess amount over the vouchers amount and non-accounting of such excess drawl
Non deduction of previous payments made to the executants in subsequent bills in departmental execution
Non refund of unutilised advance even after the purpose is over in case of departmental execution
Self cheques drawn for recoveries or advances not remitted and disbursed
Tampering of Amount noted in the remittance challans
Transfer of cash balance from one cash book to another not accounted for in the destination cash book
